## 3. Goals

- **G-1** — Readers keep track of the books they want to read and have read. Added: v1.0

## 5. Functional requirements

### Reading list

- **R-1** — WHEN a reader adds a book, the system shall put it on that reader's list. Traces: G-1 · Added: v1.0
- **R-2** — WHEN a reader marks a book as read, the system shall show it as read. Traces: G-1 · Added: v1.0
- **R-3** — The system shall show a reading list only to its owner. Traces: G-1 · Added: v1.1
